card.name: Inside phenobarbital and similar drug names
card.fires_on: The 'b' inside 'phenobarbital' (also 'pentobarbital') when it appears in lists of anticonvulsants or enzyme-inducing drugs. One weaker case is the 'L' in 'cL' in a fever and ANC line.

modes.label: Barbiturate names
modes.description: The letter 'b' partway through phenobarbital or pentobarbital, usually in drug-interaction lists.

modes.label: Stray letter
modes.description: A single letter at the start of a short clinical phrase about fever or ANC.
modes.example: c<<L>> with fever or ANC less than 5
